calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_change, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dn, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) vat_diff, sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) vat_calc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH a AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) stores, sum(a.net) a_net, sum(b.rpt) b_rpt, sum(CASE WHEN abs(a.net-b.rpt)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatched_stores, count(a.store_id) a_n, count(b.store_id) b_n
FROM a FULL JOIN b USING (store_id)

(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
